about_the_game:
About This Game

Exiled. Alone. Trapped on a hostile alien world.
You play as a man cast out from Earth for failing to pay his debts. Sentenced to exile, you awake on a deadly, radioactive planet — your only lifeline: an aging van.

This is a 2D open-world survival game where every second matters. You'll gather alien flora, mine rare minerals, and craft upgrades to survive the planet’s escalating dangers. The van isn’t just your home — it’s your lifeboat. Keep it running, improve it, and use it to explore a vast world teeming with secrets and threats.

Features:

  • A massive handcrafted world featuring 10 diverse biomes and unique sub-zones

  • 18 types of alien plants, 10 types of trees, and 6 mineable resources

  • Deep upgrade system for your van — fuel efficiency, armor, cargo, cooling systems, and more

  • Survival under pressure: manage heat, radiation, and time as dangers intensify

  • Dynamic climate with localized weather systems and random events

  • 10 unique enemy types, each with their own behavior and tactics

  • Stay in the van: everything you do — fighting, exploring, collecting — happens from inside

  • Find a way to escape... or watch the planet swallow you whole

The longer you survive, the harder it gets. Will you adapt… or disappear?

content_descriptors.notes: Bad language. Alcohol and drug abuse.

  • Processor: Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 256 MB graphics memory and opengl 2.1 compatible gpu
  • Storage: 5000 MB available space
